channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Órgão da ONU diz que atuação da Meta pode comprometer eleição brasileira e pede reparações
item.description: UN special rapporteurs warn that Meta's activities could undermine the integrity of Brazil's 2026 electoral process, calling for measures to ensure transparency and fundamental rights. The alert strengthens international monitoring regarding potential undue influence on the elections.

item.title: Moraes manda prender réu do 8/1 que atuou como 'fiscal do PL' na Argentina
item.description: Supreme Court minister Alexandre de Moraes ordered the preventive arrest of 52-year-old Claudiomiro da Rosa Soares, charged in connection with the January 8 riots and accused of acting as a PL party monitor in Argentina during elections. The arrest aims to reinforce legal security and deter further violence against democratic institutions.

item.title: Flávio diz que aceita abrir sigilo se Marcola fizer o mesmo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro accepted the challenge to release his phone records, conditional on Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro (Marcola) and others linked to President Lula doing the same. At an event in São Paulo, the candidate demanded transparency over the Lula Institute’s accounts, corporate card expenses, and Alvorada Palace visitor logs.

item.title: Caso das joias: Bolsonaro pede prazo para contestar infração apontada pela Receita
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's defense team requested Minister Alexandre de Moraes to reopen the deadline to contest a tax violation notice from the Federal Revenue Service in the Saudi jewelry case. Lawyers claim the summons was sent to an old address. The case involves investigations into gifts received by Bolsonaro during his presidential term.

item.title: Especialistas da ONU cobram ações da Meta contra ‘restrições’ nas eleições
item.description: UN experts demand action from Meta over alleged restrictions on free expression during the Brazilian elections, calling for transparency and redress mechanisms. The complaint includes restrictions on campaign posts, engagement, and reach across the company's platforms.

item.title: Um raro nome de peso do mercado financeiro na campanha contra Flávio
item.description: Fersen Lambranho, co-chairman of GP Investments' council, has publicly criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's policies, likening his aides to past figures and warning about risks to Brazil. He emphasizes concerns about far-right movements and advocates for sustainable investments.

item.title: Flávio lista condições para abrir sigilos e vê “promessa vazia” de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro agreed to open financial, fiscal and telephone records of companies and professionals linked to him, but set conditions for President Lula, demanding transparency on federal spending, the first lady's agenda and the use of presidential helicopters. He labeled Lula's proposal as an 'empty promise', arguing it would not reveal any irregularities. The exchange takes place amid the electoral dispute and involves lawsuits related to Lula's assets.

item.title: Líder do PSB declara apoio a Motta e partido negocia federação com PDT
item.description: The leader of the PSB in the Chamber, Jonas Donizette, declared support for the re-election of Hugo Motta (Republicans-PB) to the presidency of the Chamber and announced negotiations for a federation with the PDT to expand the parliamentary group. Donizette also commented on the Senate race, indicating a preference for Davi Alcolumbre (União Brasil-AP), and suggested that João Campos (PSB) could take a ministry in a Lula government after his defeat in Pernambuco.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest, agenda de Flávio e Lula e outras notícias desta quarta-feira; siga
item.description: Senator Flávio Dornaubode has not confirmed his participation in the SBT town hall for the presidential runoff, maintaining his schedule in Fortaleza. Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva completed his interview the previous night.

item.title: Lula pede em carta que prefeitos comparem sua gestão com a de Bolsonaro
item.description: Lula sent a letter to mayors and councilors comparing his administration with Bolsonaro's, one week before the runoff election against Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Willer Tomaz diz ser sócio de operadora da Loterj em e-mail obtido pela PF
item.description: Lawyer Willer Tomaz, a friend of Flávio Bolsonaro, stated in an email that he is a partner or shareholder in companies linked to Rio Pag, the operator of Lottery of Rio de Janeiro bets. The information was published by columnist Malu Gaspar from O Globo after being obtained by the Federal Police.

item.title: Fotos inéditas mostram viagem de Lulinha e lobista em jatinho de 20 milhões de dólares
item.description: Lula denied knowing lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, calling her a ‘pilantra’ (slut), amid investigations linking her to the president’s son in securing government contracts. The lobbyist, who has received threats, is waiting until after the elections to act, per legal advice.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 45% e Lula marca 44%, a 4 dias da eleição
item.description: A Quaest poll released four days before the 2026 presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 45% and Lula (PT) at 44%. Blank and null votes account for 9%, while 2% remain undecided. Rejection of Lula dropped from 53% to 47% in a week, and Flávio's rejection moved from 54% to 52%.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Quaest sobre a disputa Flávio x Lula a quatro dias do 2º turno
item.description: Quaest poll released 4 days before the 2026 runoff shows technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (45%) and Lula (44%), with Lula stable and Bolsonaro slightly down from previous survey.

item.title: Quaest: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 45% e Lula, 44%, no 2º turno
item.description: A Quaest survey released on October 21 shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) with 45% and Lula (PT) with 44% in second-round voting intentions, technically tied due to the margin of error. The poll surveyed 2,154 people between October 17 and 20, commissioned by Grupo Globo.

item.title: Quaest, 2º turno: Flávio Bolsonaro, 45%; Lula, 44%
item.description: Quaest poll for the 2026 Brazilian presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 45% and Lula (PT) at 44%, within the ±2 percentage point margin of error. The survey, commissioned by Globo and O Globo, interviewed 2,154 people between October 17-20.

item.title: Quaest: 47% desaprovam governo Lula e 46% aprovam
item.description: A Quaest poll for the presidential runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) at 45% and 44%, respectively. Government approval for Lula rises to 46%, while disapproval drops to 47%, within a two-point margin of error. The survey was conducted from October 17 to 20, polling 2,154 voters aged 16 and above as registered with the TSE.

item.title: Quaest: 47% desaprovam governo Lula, enquanto 46% aprovam gestão do petista
item.description: Quaest poll shows a technical tie in approval for Lula's administration, with 46% approving and 47% disapproving, amid renewed campaign promises and mutual attacks between Lula and Flávio ahead of the runoff.

item.title: Quaest: Lula avança entre eleitores de Cury no segundo turno, enquanto Flávio cresce entre apoiadores de Renan e Caiado
item.description: In a tight race for the runoff, Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro vie for third-way voters. Cury supporters lean toward Lula (48%), while Caiado backers split between Flávio (57%) and Lula (21%). Among Renan voters, 51% choose Flávio, and Lula leads among non-voters from the first round.

item.title: Quaest: indecisos dobra e chega a 14% na pesquisa espontânea
item.description: A Quaest poll shows undecided voters nearly double to 14%, with Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro tied at 40% each in the spontaneous second-round simulation. The survey included 2,154 interviews with a 95% confidence level and was registered under BR-08535/2026.

item.title: Quaest: a dias do 2º turno, rejeição de Lula recua a 47% e a de Flávio vai a 52%
item.description: A Quaest poll shows Lula's rejection rate dropped from 53% to 47% in a week, while Flávio Bolsonaro's fell from 54% to 52%, within the margin of error. The survey, conducted after the first debate between the candidates, indicates both remain widely rejected by the public, with 47% of valid votes for Flávio and 45% for Lula according to October 4 data.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Flávio tem 45%, e Lula marca 44%; distância diminui a quatro dias da eleição
item.description: A Quaest poll released four days before the runoff shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (45%) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (44%), within a two-point margin of error. The campaign focuses on security, Bolsa Família, and AI analysis, amid growing street and online mobilizations.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lidera numericamente, mas segue empatado com Lula, diz pesquisa Meio/Ideia
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro leads with 48% of voting intentions in the second round, against 46% for Lula, within the margin of error, according to Meio/Ideia research. Among valid votes, Flávio reaches 51.1%, while Lula has 48.9%. Both face high rejection rates, but Flávio's Ministry of Prosperity proposal attracts voters linking improved living standards to entrepreneurship.

item.title: Bolsa abre em leve alta, aos 208 mil pontos, à espera de pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: The Brazilian stock market opened slightly higher, with the Ibovespa around 208,000 points, as international markets monitor economic data and a latest poll tied Flávio Bolsonaro and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The Quaest survey showed Flávio leading with 45% voter intentions versus Lula's 44%, while the Meio/Ideia poll gave the PL candidate 51.1% and the president 48.9%. The US dollar and oil prices remain steady, with the dollar at R$5.01 and oil below $110.

item.title: Transporte gratuito nos fins de semana: o debate sobre o mérito não dispensa a conta
item.description: The federal government proposes free public transportation on weekends, with an estimated cost of R$ 12 billion. The measure depends on resources from parliamentary amendments and requires negotiation with lawmakers. In addition, the increase in passenger flow may raise the fiscal impact.

item.title: O sigilo dos segredos (por Tânia Fusco)
item.description: The text discusses the need for financial transparency among political candidates, criticizing the retention of banking and phone secrecy. It argues that opening these records would help uncover potential corruption and irregular funding, especially in presidential elections, and questions the stance of candidates who accuse opponents without evidence. The author suggests that, in an ideal world, it should be mandatory for all candidates to open their bank records.

item.title: Felca tem título cancelado e não votará do 2º turno das eleições
item.description: Felca, influencer known for his video 'Adultização', had his voter ID canceled by the TSE for missing three consecutive elections, preventing him from voting in the 2026 runoff. In his new YouTube content, he discusses his struggle with social phobia, linking it to bullying experienced between the ages of 12 and 18.

item.title: Pesquisa Palver mostra Flávio Bolsonaro numericamente à frente de Lula
item.description: The Palver poll released on October 21, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva in the presidential runoff race, with 50% of voting intentions against Lula's 48%. Conducted between October 18 and 20 with 5,000 respondents, the poll has a margin of error of ±2.4 percentage points.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio vai a evento de campanha em Guarulhos
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) takes part in two campaign events on October 21, 2026: one alongside Governor Tarcísio de Freitas in Guarulhos (SP) and another at the Bloco do 22 rally in Fortaleza (CE), both aimed at boosting momentum ahead of the presidential runoff vote.

item.title: BBC News Brasil faz transmissão AO VIVO para você acompanhar apuração e resultados do 2º turno
item.description: BBC News Brasil broadcasts live coverage of the 2026 runoff election results, with real-time updates starting at 7:30 AM Brasília time. Over 158.7 million voters elect the president, governors, and mayors. The live show features analysis of polls, expert interviews, and commentary from journalists Camilla Veras Mota, Nathália Passarinho, Mariana Schreiber, and Laís Alegretti.

item.title: TSE suspende propaganda de Lula que associa Flávio a assédio
item.description: The TSE suspended an advertisement from Lula's campaign that linked Flávio Bolsonaro to harassment scenarios, ruling that the edit could amount to dishonoring the lawmaker. The decision was issued by Minister Marco Aurélio Bellizze in a preliminary analysis. The content used the phrase 'I am the president's son. Want to give me?' intercut with staged scenes.

item.title: Ratinho Jr pede votos para Flávio e Greca declara apoio a Lula em racha de chapa derrotada no Paraná
item.description: After electoral loss, Ratinho Jr. and Sandro Alex endorse Flávio Bolsonaro, while Rafael Greca supports Lula in a split ruling party slate in Paraná.

item.title: Crusoé: Eleitores de Lula querem CLT, os de Flávio, empreender
item.description: Meio/Idea survey shows slight advantage for Flávio Bolsonaro over Lula in the presidential race, highlighting distinct voter profiles: Lula supporters favor labor rights and CLT, whereas Flávio's voters prioritize entrepreneurship.

item.title: Se eleito, Flávio Bolsonaro teria que superar obstáculos constitucionais para rever o fim da escala 6×1
item.description: If elected, Flávio Bolsonaro will need a new constitutional amendment in Congress to reinstate the 6×1 work scale, as the Brazilian Constitution requires qualified majority and does not allow changes via decree or provisional measure. His allies advocate for flexible working hours and individual negotiations, but constitutional procedures and potential Supreme Court challenges may complicate labor reforms.

item.title: Lula edita MP com R$ 6,4 bi em crédito extra para Brasil Soberano
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva issued Provisional Measure 1.397, authorizing BRL 6.49 billion in additional funding to support exporters and suppliers under the Brasil Soberano Plan, a program created to mitigate the impact of U.S. trade tariffs. The funds will be managed by the Export Guarantee Fund, linked to the Ministry of Finance, and take effect on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, with a 120-day deadline for conversion into law by the National Congress.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 51% dos votos válidos, ante 49% de Lula, diz pesquisa Palver
item.description: Palver poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro leading with 51% of valid votes against Lula's 49% in a hypothetical second round, with a 2-point margin. Conducted October 18-20 with 5,000 respondents, the survey also reveals that proposals like IPVA reduction and new maximum-security prisons significantly influence voting intentions.

item.title: Proposta dos candidatos para crédito levam a juros maiores
item.description: Lula advocates for an expansive credit policy, while Flávio Bolsonaro and Daniella Marques propose using Caixa to increase credit access. These proposals may lead to higher interest rates.

item.title: Uso de IA, reajuste para servidores, concursos e privatizações colocam Lula e Flávio em lados opostos
item.description: Lula and Flávio hold opposing views on administrative reform, privatizations, and AI policies in the public sector, reflecting distinct positions on economy and public management. Their proposals place the candidates on opposite sides in the 2026 electoral debate.

item.title: O Bolsa Família na reta final da eleição - O Assunto #1829
item.description: The Bolsa Família program, created in 2003 to combat poverty in Brazil, returned to electoral rhetoric between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, who propose distinct changes regarding benefit values and eligibility rules. According to an FGV study, 85% of formal jobs created since 2023 were filled by program beneficiaries, highlighting its role in social inclusion and local economic development.

item.title: Plenário do TSE mantém remoção de post que associa Flávio à "rachadinha"
item.description: The TSE plenary unanimously upheld the removal of social media posts linking senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to 'Operation Unha e Carne' due to lack of factual evidence. The ruling reinforces the protection of candidates' images against unsubstantiated accusations during the electoral campaign.

item.title: Lula envia ao Congresso nesta quarta PEC que prevê tarifa zero para ônibus aos finais de semana
item.description: President Lula sends to Congress a constitutional amendment bill establishing free public transport on weekends, funded by cutting parliamentary amendments. The measure expands benefits set by the amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule and is part of a wave of popular announcements in the final stretch of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula sanciona nesta quarta lei que prevê perdão de dívidas e aumento do teto de faturamento para MEI
item.description: President Lula signed the law creating the Prospera MEI program, offering debt forgiveness, raising the revenue ceiling to R$140,000 by 2028, and allowing two employees per microentrepreneur. The measure benefits over 17.6 million MEIs with an estimated fiscal impact of R$3.38 billion in 2029.

item.title: Qual é o número de Flávio Bolsonaro, candidato do PL à Presidência da República
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate for Brazil's presidency, has the ballot number 22. The October 25 election will determine the office, with voting order varying by state. The TSE confirms 158.7 million eligible voters.

item.title: Qual é o número de Lula, candidato do PT à Presidência da República
item.description: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, PT candidate for re-election to the Presidency, has the ballot number 13. In the second round on October 25, the ballot will display only two options (president and governor in some states), with 158.7 million eligible voters registered with the TSE.

item.title: Quaest divulga nova pesquisa presidencial nesta quarta-feira (21)
item.description: Quaest releases a presidential poll for the 2026 runoff, showing a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. Datafolha will publish its own poll on Thursday.

item.title: De Bolsa Família à maioridade penal: veja o que Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula mudaram em seus discursos
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula shifted stances on issues like Bolsa Família and juvenile justice during the 2026 campaign, signaling political repositioning. Flávio now supports the social program after previous criticisms, while Lula backs lowering the age of criminal responsibility for serious crimes, reversing his progressive stance. These changes reflect ideological adjustments tailored to electoral dynamics.

item.title: Campanha petista tenta convencer Lula a entrar no canal de WhatsApp comandado por Janones
item.description: Members of Lula's campaign are trying to convince him to join the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', created by André Janones and followed by nearly 6.5 million people. Despite the surge in digital engagement, Lula remains hesitant and has not yet fulfilled his promise to buy a phone once the group reached 5 million followers.

item.title: Advogado Willer Tomaz foi o maior apostador do Brasil em 2025, aponta Secretaria de Apostas
item.description: The Secretariat of Prizes and Bets identified lawyer Willer Tomaz as Brazil's top bettor in 2025 with $1 billion in bets, raising money laundering suspicions due to high-volume transactions and suspicious patterns.

item.title: Escritório de Flávio emitiu R$ 13,7 milhões em notas sem detalhar serviços
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) law firm issued BRL 13.7 million in invoices between January 2023 and July 2025, many without specifying services rendered, during his Senate term and pre-presidential campaign. Clients include companies like Sam's, Inovaconnect, and figures linked to investigated companies. The invoices only mention legal fees or counsel without clear transactions or explanations.

item.title: "Exército do Lula" ultrapassa 6 milhões de seguidores a 5 dias do 2º turno
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula', managed by federal deputy André Janones, surpassed 6 million followers five days before the second round of the presidential election. Janones celebrated the growth and announced the channel will remain closed until it reaches 7 million subscribers, promising to mathematically prove Lula's reelection. The group was used to mobilize supporters of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
